g.text: Normals: J28 CV2 NORM (CV 1's tip: CV 2 follows CV 1); J27 OUT2 NORM (OUT 2 -> R113 36k -> channel 1's I-to-V: OUTPUT carries both, OUT 2 inverted).

g.desc: Normals: J28 CV2 NORM (CV 1's tip: CV 2 follows CV 1); J27 OUT2 NORM (OUT 2 -> R113 36k -> channel 1's I-to-V: OUTPUT carries both, OUT 2 inverted).

g.text: Iabc = CV_AMT/18k + CV_VCA/18k + LEVEL/22k; 0.44 mA (unity gain) at +8 V CV, 1.75 mA max. Linear response.
